title: How to organize the refrigerator and freezer | Kitchen
description:
Cold storage that has to keep food safe and show you what you already own before you shop.

This is the Refrigerator and Freezer in the Kitchen. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Raw meat sealed on the lowest shelf. Leftovers in clear containers at eye level, each with a name and a date on the lid. One bin marked for what must be eaten this week, sitting where the door opens straight onto it. The vents at the back wall clear of anything pressed against them, the door holding condiments only, and nothing in the freezer without a label.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Work one shelf at a time so nothing sits out warming while you decide.
Straighten: Raw proteins go on the lowest shelf, where a leaking package cannot drip onto anything below it.
Shine: Pull the crisper drawers right out and wash them in the sink, because the sticky ring under a drawer is where
Safety: Raw meat sealed and stored below ready-to-eat food is nearly the whole of cross contamination prevention in on
Standardize: A roll of tape and a marker live on top of the fridge, and nothing goes in without a name and a date on the li
Sustain: Before you write the shopping list, the eat-first bin gets emptied of anything past, and the list gets written

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Raw meat low and sealed, dated containers at eye level, one eat-first bin at the front, and the rear vents clear.
